description: Good companies at cheap prices: the sum of the ranks of earnings yield on enterprise value and return on capital (ROE as proxy). Fundamentals are point-in-time: only figures filed on or before each rebalance are used. Falsified if it does not beat the equal-weight benchmark after 10 bps costs.
title: Magic formula · EBITDA/EV plus ROE · top 50 of the Top 500 (after Greenblatt 2005) · long only
